scientific_integrity: Infinite-alphabet dimension and asymptotics follow from the supplied analytic proof. Finite numerical and rational diagnostics are supporting checks only; no independent verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Specific affine, isolated, polynomially weighted countable branches; with only immediate label repetitions excluded; requires q>1 and eta(q)>0 tending to zero; no claims about closures, fixed positive leakage, or arbitrary nonlinear systems.
title: Critical collision–leakage dimension law for countably branched expanding maps
